mechanism: Both drugs can cause QT prolongation and electrolyte abnormalities (particularly hypocalcemia and hypomagnesemia with foscarnet), increasing risk of cardiac arrhythmias; foscarnet also increases seizure risk which may be potentiated by hydroxychloroquine's CNS effects.
action: Monitor ECG and electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, potassium) regularly; consider alternative antiviral if possible; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation with foscarnet therapy.
